summary.zh: 跟着作者公开视频观察可操作的方块世界，再把作品展示与模型消息分开核对。
summary.en: Follow the creator’s public voxel-world demos, then separate the artwork from model reports.

scope.zh: 频道公开简介列出 Jazii 与 Salio 的展示、Business Insider 报道和 Google 公告，没有提供对应 GitHub 仓库；本次也未核验到可对应的公开实现。Fable 5.5 是作者对帖子的标注，不能据此确认后台模型。Carbon 是媒体报道，Argon 的可用范围以 Google 公告为准。
scope.en: The public description links demos by Jazii and Salio, a Business Insider report and a Google announcement, but no matching GitHub repository. No matching public implementation was verified in this review. Fable 5.5 is the creator’s label, not confirmation of the backend model. Carbon is a media report; Argon availability follows Google’s announcement.

summary.zh: 把 GPT-Next 标签、Codex 提速说法和 dots 邮件演示分开看，标明各自来源。
summary.en: Separate the GPT-Next label, a Codex speed claim and a Dots email demo by their sources.

scope.zh: 本期引用 Fandu 与 Tibo 的公开帖子及 OpenAI 资料，没有提供对应演示作品的 GitHub 仓库；本次未核验到公开配套源码。GPT-Next 是发帖者标签；约 50% TPS 与 28 天改进承诺均为 Tibo 的表述，不是独立测速。宝塔、厨房和体素作品的制作方式与模型身份仍未确认。
scope.en: The episode cites public posts by Fandu and Tibo plus OpenAI material, but does not provide a GitHub repo for the demos; no matching source was verified here. GPT-Next is the poster’s label. The roughly 50% TPS figure and 28-day improvement commitment are Tibo’s claims, not independent measurements. The creator and model behind the pagoda, kitchen and voxel works remain unconfirmed.

summary.zh: 对照 Image Blaster、WorldClaw 与 Atlas，分别看单图房间生成、场景扩展和镜头路线展示。
summary.en: Compare Image Blaster, WorldClaw and Atlas across single-image room generation, scene expansion and camera-path demos.

scope.zh: Image Blaster 的 GitHub 仓库含有与本期单图生成演示对应的公开实现。Tencent-Hunyuan/WorldClaw 仓库提供论文、项目页和配图，本次核对的仓库内容未见实现代码，因此作为参考资料列出。World Labs Atlas 对应官方介绍页；本期未自行复测生成速度或精度。
scope.en: The Image Blaster GitHub repository contains the public implementation corresponding to this episode’s single-image workflow. Tencent-Hunyuan/WorldClaw links its paper, project page and assets; the reviewed repository contents do not include implementation code, so it is listed as a reference. World Labs Atlas is linked to its official article. Generation speed and accuracy were not retested here.

summary.zh: 相关论文与项目页参考；当前链接仓库以论文、项目页和配图为主，未见实现代码。
summary.en: A related paper and project-page reference; the linked repository currently provides the paper, project page and assets, not implementation code.

summary.zh: 从 Fable 视觉演示与 OpenAI dots 案例，检查支付摘要、反馈分析和回复草稿停在哪一步。
summary.en: Review where payment summaries, feedback analysis and reply drafts stop in Fable and OpenAI Dots demos.

scope.zh: 公开简介引用作者帖子与 OpenAI dots 展示，没有提供配套 GitHub 仓库；本次未核验到演示作品的公开源码。Fable 5.5 与 Argon 是原帖标注，不能据此确认模型身份。dots 演示中的支付摘要不是预订确认，反馈样例存在时间缺口，回复仍停在草稿审核；不把展示升级成已完成的业务结果。
scope.en: The public description links creator posts and an OpenAI Dots demo, but no matching GitHub repository; public source for the demonstrated work was not verified here. Fable 5.5 and Argon remain labels from the original posts, not confirmed model identities. The Dots payment summary is not a booking, the feedback sample has a time gap, and the reply remains a draft for review; the demo is not presented as completed work.

summary.zh: 观察公开游戏、网页和 3D 交互展示，再对照 OpenAI 发布的产品资料。
summary.en: Review public game, web and 3D interaction demos alongside OpenAI’s product announcements.

scope.zh: 公开视频简介把前半段标作公开作品展示，并链接 GPT-6.1 Sol、Dots 与 DevDay 官方页面；没有提供演示作品的配套 GitHub 仓库，本次未核验到公开源码。片中展示不是同条件复现或本频道实测，模型归属沿用视频中的标注。
scope.en: The public description presents the first half as public demos and links official GPT-6.1 Sol, Dots and DevDay pages. It provides no GitHub repository for the demonstrated work, and no matching public source was verified here. These are not controlled reproductions or this channel’s tests; model attribution follows the video.
